nodes.label: Theme Intelligence Engine
nodes.rationale: Mines Pinterest for best on-theme photography to build reference embedding + compositional profile; drives smarter photo selection. One-time offline Phase A harvest (Apify + Pinterest) → Phase C production corpus from open/licensed APIs (Unsplash, Pexels, etc).

nodes.label: Appless Contribution Flow
nodes.rationale: Organizer shares QR or scenr.app/join/slug link. Contributor opens in mobile browser, tap-to-choose/drag-drop photos+videos, optional name. No account; presigned direct-to-storage upload; pool updates Live. Session token for attribution.

nodes.label: Captions System (3 Modes)
nodes.rationale: Write your own (free-text editor), Generate from content (VLM reads media + trip metadata, drafts caption with hashtags), Theme preset (template with auto-filled slots). Always editable before export.

nodes.label: Free vs Premium Tier System
nodes.rationale: Free: capped uploads/trip + 2 trips/month. Premium ($12.99/mo or $99.99/yr): unlimited, no watermark, all 15 themes, full theme-fit. Server-authoritative enforcement; client displays quota.

nodes.label: API Gateway / BFF (Kong + GraphQL)
nodes.rationale: Stateless edge: TLS termination, routing, JWT validation, rate limiting, quota pre-checks, presigned upload brokering, GraphQL schema stitching, response caching. Owns no domain data. Scales horizontally behind LB.

nodes.label: Auth & User Service (JWT/OAuth)
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for identity, accounts, sessions, JWKS, plan flags. Stateless, always-on, cheap-to-scale tier.

nodes.label: Media Ingestion (Upload Brokering)
nodes.rationale: Presigned direct-to-storage uploads, type/size validation, malware/NSFW scanning, resumable chunking. Media bypasses gateway entirely. Appless and in-app uploaders check quota before accepting.
